verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only building blocks: built-in pipeline metrics (TTFS/latency), and a community-described debugger, Whisker, for inspecting frames in real time. Neither is documented as production call monitoring, and nothing in the pack covers alerts on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes. These primitives could feed a monitoring stack, but they are not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike
